description: Decodes an Everloot talent share code (EL1-<class>-<spec>-<build>-<payload>, or a calculator link carrying one after #plan=) against the class's trees: the talents and ranks it holds, points per tree, the lowest level that can hold it, and every problem in plain words: a code made on another build, nodes the tree does not have, ranks cut back, points the rules would not place. Nothing is dropped silently. Game-file data, found in game files, unconfirmed.

code.description: The share code, or a link that carries one.

name: talent_plan

codeBuild.description: The game build the code was made on.

link.description: The calculator with this plan loaded.

minLevel.description: The lowest level that can hold this many points.

ok.description: False when the code could not be read at all; message says why.

problems.description: One sentence each. Empty means the code loaded exactly as made.

choice.description: The chosen entry of a choice node, zero-based.

treeBuild.description: The build of the trees it was read against.

url.description: The build's own link on everloot.app, absolute: the calculator opened on this plan, with a preview card for sharing.

title: Read a talent share code
